candidates.excerpt: Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu is expected to meet Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal in New Delhi soon after the fifth round of negotiations on the India-Canada comprehensive economic partnership agreement (CEPA.

candidates.title: Telangana: Eight arrested with 13 kg deer meat near Raikal Toll Plaza
candidates.excerpt: Eight persons were arrested after police allegedly caught them transporting around 13 kg of deer meat near Raikal Toll Plaza in Telangana. An air gun and two vehicles were seized, while police and Forest Department officials are investigating the alleged hunting.

candidates.title: Five-year-old dies in rockfall on Kedarnath route; around 1,000 pilgrims rescued
candidates.excerpt: A five-year-old boy died after being struck by a falling stone near Chirbasa on Uttarakhand’s Kedarnath trekking route. Rockfall debris blocked the route, prompting rescue operations for stranded pilgrims. Char Dham Yatra remained suspended amid heavy rainfall and weather alerts
